description: This file contains the implementation of ExpressionResolver class used in Apache Spark SQL Catalyst module for resolving expressions during query analysis. It handles various expression types, attribute resolution, subqueries, and type coercion, and manages expression resolution context and attributes referencing.

classes.name: ExpressionResolver
classes.description: A class responsible for resolving expressions in Spark SQL Catalyst during query analysis, handling various expression types, attribute resolution, subqueries, type coercion, and context management.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Main method to resolve an unresolved expression into a fully resolved expression, handling different expression types and applying type coercion.

methods.name: resolveExpressionTreeInOperator
methods.description: Resolves an expression tree within the context of a parent operator (LogicalPlan).

methods.name: resolveLiteral
methods.description: Resolves Literal expressions, especially with default collation.

methods.name: resolveGetViewColumnByNameAndOrdinal
methods.description: Resolves GetViewColumnByNameAndOrdinal expressions by matching attribute names or ordinals.

methods.name: resolveExpressionGenerically
methods.description: Resolves an expression by resolving its children without special handling.

methods.name: resolveExpressionGenericallyWithTypeCoercion
methods.description: Resolves an expression with type coercion applied after resolving children.

methods.name: resolveExpressionGenericallyWithTimezoneWithTypeCoercion
methods.description: Resolves timezone-aware expressions with timezone resolution and type coercion.

methods.name: validateResolvedExpressionGenerically
methods.description: Validates a resolved expression for type correctness and resolution status.

methods.name: tryDrainLazySequences
methods.description: Converts lazy sequences like LazyList or Stream to List for determinism.

methods.name: throwUnsupportedSinglePassAnalyzerFeature
methods.description: Throws an error for unsupported expression resolution features.

methods.name: throwSinglePassFailedToResolveExpression
methods.description: Throws an error if an expression fails to resolve.

methods.name: throwFailedToResolveRuntimeReplaceableExpression
methods.description: Throws an error if a runtime replaceable expression cannot be resolved.
